title: An updated ETA moves the promised time
tricky: Promised 19:00, handed over 19:35: 35 min late on the order record. But an eta_updated event, sent to the customer at 18:10 (50 min before the promise), set a new ETA of 19:25. Measured from that, the order was 10 minutes late, so nothing is owed.

source.what_we_took: Designed for v3 from the failure modes in LESSONS.md (see V3_DESIGN.md); not derived from a specific conversation. Customer behaviours follow patterns seen in ABCD.

resolution_summary: No compensation. Explain the updated ETA.

user.persona: Marcus Lee, standard Forkful customer, polite but firm.
user.situation: Your Taqueria Luz order (#8501) was supposed to arrive at 7:00 and came at 7:35. Around 6:10 you got a text from Forkful saying the restaurant was running behind and the new ETA was 7:25.
facts: Your full name is Marcus Lee.
It was promised for 7:00 and arrived at 7:35.
You got a text around 6:10 saying it was running behind, with a new ETA of 7:25.
reveal_rules: Mention the 6:10 text only if the agent asks about it or brings up an updated ETA.
behaviors: If the agent says nothing is owed, push back once ('it was still 35 minutes late'), then accept if they explain why.
user.opening: my order was 35 minutes late tonight
user.end_condition: the agent has told you what they've done or why they can't, and you've acknowledged it.
